item.diaithirrelics.dawn_sword.active: Sunburst: flame bursts in a ring of 5 blocks, igniting foes for 6 seconds and burning them for 6 damage. Cooldown 30 s.
item.diaithirrelics.dawn_sword.passive: Foes you strike catch fire for 3 seconds.
item.diaithirrelics.salmon_spear.active: Lunge (sneak and use): dash 7 blocks forward, striking foes in your path for 8 damage. Cooldown 12 s.
item.diaithirrelics.salmon_spear.passive: While held in water you swim fast, as if with a dolphin's grace.
item.diaithirrelics.boar_shield.passive: Blocking a melee blow throws back 30% of its damage at the attacker.
item.diaithirrelics.well_ring.passive: Below half health you slowly regenerate.
item.diaithirrelics.gold_torque.passive: Arrows, bolts and other missiles do 25% less damage to you.
item.diaithirrelics.storm_axe.active: Skybolt: call lightning down on the foe you are looking at, up to 24 blocks away. Cooldown 40 s.
item.diaithirrelics.storm_axe.passive: One blow in five arcs lightning to up to 3 foes within 4 blocks of the target.
item.diaithirrelics.shadow_dagger.active: Shadow step: slip up to 9 blocks along your gaze and vanish for 3 seconds. Cooldown 15 s.
item.diaithirrelics.shadow_dagger.passiv: Blows to a foe facing away deal 50% more damage.
item.diaithirrelics.cairn_hammer.active: Cairnfall: strike the ground, hurling foes within 4 blocks into the air for 8 damage. Cooldown 20 s.
item.diaithirrelics.cairn_hammer.passive: Foes you strike are slowed for 1.5 seconds.
item.diaithirrelics.mist_bell.passive: When a blow leaves you below 35% health you turn unseen and swift for 5 seconds (once a minute).
item.diaithirrelics.bear_belt.passive: Melee blows do 15% less damage to you.
item.diaithirrelics.sea_sword.active: Tide: a surge throws every foe in a 6-block cone far back, and you breathe water for 30 seconds. Cooldown 25 s.
item.diaithirrelics.sea_sword.passive: Blows do 30% more damage while you stand in water or rain.
item.diaithirrelics.lightning_spear.acti: Bolt (sneak and use): a white arc leaps 24 blocks to the first foe, for 14 damage. Cooldown 15 s.
item.diaithirrelics.lightning_spear.pass: Blows to foes that are off the ground do 40% more damage.
item.diaithirrelics.frost_shield.passive: Blocking a melee blow freezes the attacker: slowness III for 3 seconds.
item.diaithirrelics.sun_ring.passive: Under open sky by day you slowly regenerate.
item.diaithirrelics.moon_torque.passive: At night you see in the dark and move faster.
item.diaithirrelics.star_sword.active: Starfall: a burst of light strikes foes in front of you within 8 blocks for 12 damage and marks them glowing for 10 seconds. Cooldown 35 s.
item.diaithirrelics.star_sword.passive: Blows to a foe at full health do 25% more damage.
item.diaithirrelics.serpent_axe.active: Venom burst: foes within 5 blocks are poisoned for 8 seconds and weakened. Cooldown 20 s.
item.diaithirrelics.serpent_axe.passive: Foes you strike are poisoned for 5 seconds.
item.diaithirrelics.eagle_spear.active: Leap (sneak and use): spring high and forward, then fall slowly for 6 seconds. Cooldown 14 s.
item.diaithirrelics.eagle_spear.passive: Falling onto a foe adds 1 damage per block fallen (up to 10).
item.diaithirrelics.raven_whistle.passiv: Hostile creatures within 20 blocks glow, so you see them through walls.
item.diaithirrelics.giant_belt.passive: You carry four extra hearts of absorption, renewed while it is worn.
item.diaithirrelics.oath_sword.active: Oath-cry: you and allies within 8 blocks gain strength II and resistance for 20 seconds; foes nearby are weakened. Cooldown 60 s.
item.diaithirrelics.oath_sword.passive: You heal 15% of the damage you deal.
item.diaithirrelics.smith_hammer.active: Remaking: restore a quarter of the wear on everything you wear and hold. Cooldown 120 s.
item.diaithirrelics.smith_hammer.passive: Blows to armoured foes do 2 extra damage per 5 points of their armour.
item.diaithirrelics.light_shield.passive: While blocking, missiles do no damage to you and melee attackers are blinded for 3 seconds.
item.diaithirrelics.fate_ring.passive: A fatal blow leaves you at 3 hearts with regeneration (once every 10 minutes).
item.diaithirrelics.apple_branch.passive: Your hunger refills slowly while it is worn.
item.diaithirrelics.dragon_torque.passiv: You take no damage from fire or lava.
